files.description: Cloud storage accounts (150 rows): account_id (whole number), active (True or False), quota_bytes (storage limit in bytes, whole number; the 23 unlimited accounts carry the value 9223372036854775807), used_bytes (whole number). No empty cells.

task_text: Each account gets a control total: its active flag counted as 1 (True) or 0 (False), plus quota_bytes, plus used_bytes. How many accounts have a control total above 1,000,000,000,000? `result` should be that number.
intended_computation: Number of accounts whose exact control total exceeds 10**12.

predicted_direction.reason: On 3.1 the row-wise sum of a true/false column with 64-bit integers wraps around for the unlimited accounts, so their totals become negative and are not counted; 2.x summed exactly.

notes: Drafted 2026-11-11 by pkg:TASKS_M2 for catalogue row I06; naive.py shows the invited idiom, reference.py is the version-robust reference.
